bricks.label: struct HashNode
bricks.plain_english: Defines a hash node — stores a key, a value, and a next pointer for chaining on collisions.

bricks.label: struct HashTable
bricks.plain_english: Defines the table — an array of HashNode pointers and a size field.
bricks.scene_description: Full bucket grid appears with all buckets shown as empty.
